summary: Thomas Whitehead, 18, of Houston, Texas, fell near the 14,269-ft summit of Mount Antero while with a Noah's Ark Young Life group, sustaining possible neck/spine injuries; CCSO Communications received the call ~10:40 a.m. Wednesday; Chaffee County SAR North and South mounted a joint technical rescue with ropes, immobilization equipment and a wheeled stretcher, carrying him down steep rugged terrain to the trailhead; EMS transported him to Heart of the Rockies Regional Medical Center in Salida
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR North/South; Chaffee County EMS
notes: DATE PIN NOTE: article created 2013-06-28 (Friday); story says the fall was "Wednesday" with a hospital update "at noon Thursday" -> 2013-06-26 (Wednesday verified). Inserted run 548 (Mountain Mail rotation chunk).
